notes.title: Heir Obscure: A Hunt in the Dark has launched!
notes.content:
Heir Obscure has finally released! Thank you to everyone who supported the game with their talents, testing, and guidance. You can get it for 10% off this week! This has been a great learning experience for myself personally, and if you're able to offer some feedback about your experience with the game, leaving a (possibly brutally) honest review will be hugely appreciated!

THANK YOU!

Sincerely,
Andrzej Gieralt

notes.title: One month until launch!!! Join the Closed Beta!
notes.content:
We're less than 1 month until launch!!! I'm really excited about this, and I want to make sure the game is ship-shape, and as good as it could possibly be. To do this, I need your help!

[url=https://discord.gg/Wys9YHFDY7]Join the Heir Obscure discord server to access to the beta![/url] You will immediately get a message with the key to the beta build. This is the best way to help make the game as good as possible and bug-free at launch!

I hope you enjoy the game and that you join the closed beta! See you on the discord, and see you on July 20th!

Sincerely, 
Andrzej Gieralt
IOIC

notes.title: The Heir Obscure Closed Beta Is Now Live! + New Name!
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce that the Heir Obscure Closed Beta is finally live. I want to invite anybody who takes interest in Heir Obscure over these next few days to join the closed beta so that we can make this game the best that it can possibly be. I know there are a lot of issues still present in the game, and I would really love to hear community suggestions, so that this little game can be something you all have a positive impact on!

[url=https://discord.gg/Wys9YHFDY7]Join the Heir Obscure discord server to access to the beta![/url] You will immediately get a message with the key to the beta build.

IN OTHER NEWS Heir Obscure has a slightly different new name! You may have noticed already, but the game is now called Heir Obscure: A Hunt in the Dark. I think this will help potential new players better understand that the game is a horror game, that you will be hunted, and that darkness plays a part in the game. In this case, you have a better chance of staying unseen while hiding in the shadows.

I would say the most important part of Heir Obscure is the story, especially the story that you aren't told directly - there are a lot of notes and secrets hidden throughout the map, some of these secrets will give you alternate cutscenes and ultimately might reveal a secret ending.

I hope you enjoy the game and that you join the closed beta! See you on the discord!

Sincerely, 
Andrzej Gieralt
IOIC

notes.title: The Heir Obscure Demo is Ready!
notes.content: After getting lots of feedback from beta demo playtesters, I'm really excited to finally get the demo out for Heir Obscure. I hope you all enjoy! Can't wait to hear your feedback! I will of course continue to implement any changes or fixes that need implementation, but for now, this is a huge milestone on the way to release!
